items.caption: An oracle-style graph proposed as an early form of 視 depicts an eye above a standing figure. One paleographic interpretation distinguishes it from 見, whose comparable graph has a seated figure below the eye.
items.alt: Black archaic-style drawing with an eye-like shape above a standing human figure.
items.selection_reason: It illustrates the proposed early pictographic form and the scholarly distinction from 見, while the image itself is identified as a modern redraw.

limitations.text: The drawing is a modern vector reconstruction, not an image of an excavated inscription. The standing-figure reading is a scholarly interpretation; the article notes that individual archaic graphs can remain disputed and reports an earlier, rejected reading as 望.
